title: Helix Gallery
description: A photo album wound around a vertical 3D helix that keeps turning on its own.
steps: A vertical `loop` carousel of 20 photos uses an `itemSize` of 1/13 of the space between the bars (47 pt on an iPhone 17 Pro) and `autoplay` every 1500 ms.
`itemAnimation` puts each photo at x = 0.35·width·sin(value·32°) and y = value·`itemSize`; cos(value·32°) is its depth, which sets opacity and `zIndex`.
Inside each tile `relativeProgress` turns the photo with `perspective` 800 and `rotateY` up to 55°, scales it from 0.55 to 1.05 and lights the glow ring, while `progress` drifts two star layers.
